rootCauses: Surat page reads from PortalProvider.accessibleLetters instead of a paginated API query.
/api/surat loads a batch of letters then loads all active dispositions for access filtering.
Search/filtering on the Surat page is client-side and URL update happens on every keystroke.
List response uses LetterDetail shape with detail-heavy fields available from the detail endpoint.
recommendedPatch: Use /api/surat directly from the Surat page.
Debounce search and add page size controls.
